assignmentTitle: Design of Automotive Steering Gear (Recirculating Ball Type)

criteria.title: Understanding Automotive Steering Gear Application & Scope
criteria.description: Student reviews the Automotive Steering Gear Project Charter and accepts the design brief for the recirculating-ball steering gear mechanism.

criteria.title: Steering Gear Component & Interface Identification
criteria.description: Accurate identification of Steering Shaft, Steering Input Torque, Worm Shaft, Ball Return Passage/Tube, Recirculating Steel Balls, Ball Nut, Ball-Nut Rack Teeth, Sector Gear, Sector Shaft, and Pitman Arm on the Automotive Steering Gear diagram.

criteria.title: Recirculating-Ball Principle & Friction Reduction Understanding
criteria.description: Clear conceptual understanding of how rolling contact of steel balls in helical raceways replaces sliding friction to achieve ~90% efficiency.

criteria.title: Ball-Nut Axial Motion & Kinematic Transformation
criteria.description: Accurate determination that worm rotation causes pure axial translation of the ball nut along the worm axis rather than rotation.

criteria.title: Steering Gear Design Parameters & Given Data Confirmation
criteria.description: Correct identification of given engineering parameters (Tin = 10 N-m, pitch p = 10 mm, Rs = 50 mm, Lp = 150 mm, efficiency = 90%, total turns = 3.6).

criteria.title: Worm Lead & Ball-Nut Axial Travel Calculation
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of worm lead (L = 10 mm/rev), half-lock stroke (S_lock = 18.0 mm), and total lock-to-lock travel (S_total = 36.0 mm).

criteria.title: Rack-and-Sector Angular Displacement Calculation
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of sector shaft angular displacement per turn (theta_rev = 0.20 rad = 11.459 deg) and total lock-to-lock sweep (theta_total = 0.72 rad = 41.25 deg).

criteria.title: Overall Steering Ratio, Output Torque & Pitman Arm Force
criteria.description: Determination of overall steering ratio (i_overall = 31.416:1), sector shaft output torque (Tout = 282.74 N-m), and Pitman arm steering thrust force (F_pitman = 1,884.96 N).

criteria.title: Complete Kinematic Transmission Sequence Verification
criteria.description: Comprehensive evaluation and sequencing of the complete 8-stage kinematic chain from driver steering wheel to steering linkage.

criteria.title: Engineering Assessment, Contact Stress & Backlash Recommendation
criteria.description: Evaluation of rolling contact mechanics, center-point backlash adjustment, ball material specification (AISI 52100), and steering safety.

criteria.title: Comprehensive Technical Design Report
criteria.description: Concise, structured engineering synthesis report integrating all quantitative kinematic findings, torque multiplication, safety verification, and operational recommendations for Automotive Steering Gear design.
